title: John Wick
synopsis: A widower, a puppy, a car, and the very specific organization that did not understand who they had just woken up.

nodes.text: A package on the doorstep two days after the funeral.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
“Leave it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Numb.

The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Hard—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Rain on the asphalt. A new dog at your hip. Helen's bench. You sit down and you do not get up for a while.
Word travels. The next courier knocks at the kitchen door inside of a week. Daisy growls at the right times.
Winston pours one more bourbon. You drink it slow. The Continental has rules; you and it have always agreed about that.
